name: Ontomo
source:
The protagonist is an immature fledgling onmyoji.
The qualifications required to become a first-class onmyoji is the Shikigami test (commonly known as Shikiken).  The examination day is approaching.
Let's aim for passing!

-

There is a character creation system to design your own shikigami.
